name: Trailing Star
summary: Trailing Star is a trailing stop utility EA that modifies existing position stop-losses to follow price movement. It comes in two variants: Point-based (triggers after a fixed point profit from entry) and Price-based (triggers when price crosses a user-specified entry price). The EA does not open any trades itself; it only manages stop-losses of already-open positions.
summary_zh: Trailing Star是一款移动止损工具EA，通过修改已有持仓的止损来跟踪价格走势。它有两个变体：基于点数（从入场价获利固定点数后触发）和基于价格（价格突破用户指定入场价后触发）。该EA本身不开仓，仅管理已有持仓的止损。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：这是一个纯粹的移动止损管理工具，不涉及任何开仓策略。入场条件：EA本身不开仓，仅对已有持仓进行管理。Point版本的触发条件是当持仓浮盈超过设定的entry_point点数后开始移动止损；Price版本的触发条件是当价格突破用户指定的entry_price后开始移动止损。出场条件：通过移动止损来保护利润，止损会跟随价格移动trailing_point点数的距离，当价格回撤触及移动止损时平仓。仓位管理：EA不进行任何仓位管理，也不开仓。资金管理：没有任何资金管理逻辑，不计算风险百分比或动态调整仓位。两个版本的核心逻辑相同：对于BUY仓位，当价格上升时将止损上移；对于SELL仓位，当价格下降时将止损下移，止损始终保持在距离当前价格trailing_point点数的位置。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This is a purely trailing stop management utility with no trade entry logic of its own. Entry conditions: The EA does not open positions; it only manages stop-losses on existing positions. The Point variant triggers trailing when floating profit exceeds the configured entry_point in points from the open price; the Price variant triggers when price crosses the user-specified entry_price. Exit conditions: Exits occur when price retraces to hit the trailing stop-loss, which locks in profit by following price at a distance of trailing_point points. Position sizing: The EA performs no position sizing or lot management whatsoever. Money management: There is no money management logic — no risk percentage calculation, no dynamic position sizing, no equity-based controls. Both variants share the same core mechanism: for BUY positions, the stop-loss is ratcheted upward as bid price rises; for SELL positions, the stop-loss is ratcheted downward as ask price falls, always maintaining a distance of trailing_point points from the current market price.

parameters.name: entry_point
parameters.description: 入场点数（Point版本）：浮盈达到此点数后开始移动止损
parameters.description_en: Entry points (Point version): floating profit threshold to activate trailing

parameters.name: trailing_point
parameters.description: 移动止损点数：止损与当前价格保持的距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance from current price in points

parameters.name: entry_price
parameters.description: 入场价格（Price版本）：价格突破此价位后开始移动止损
parameters.description_en: Entry price (Price version): price breakout level to activate trailing

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和配置，适合初学者使用
提供两种触发方式（点数和价格），适应不同的交易场景和需求
同时支持BUY和SELL仓位的移动止损管理，功能完整
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and configure, suitable for beginners
Provides two trigger variants (point-based and price-based) to accommodate different trading scenarios
Supports trailing stop management for both BUY and SELL positions, functionally complete
cons: PositionGetSymbol(idx)在循环中修改仓位列表时可能导致索引错位，应使用倒序循环
没有检查PositionGetSymbol的返回值是否与当前图表品种匹配，会修改其他品种的仓位
entry_point和trailing_point默认值为0，用户忘记设置时EA不会生效且无任何提示
没有对CTrade.PositionModify的返回值进行检查，修改失败时无错误处理
未考虑止损修改的最小距离限制（StopsLevel），可能导致修改请求被服务器拒绝
cons_en: PositionGetSymbol(idx) in a forward loop can cause index misalignment when the position list changes; should use reverse iteration
Does not check if PositionGetSymbol matches the current chart symbol, so it may modify positions on other symbols
entry_point and trailing_point default to 0, and if the user forgets to set them, the EA silently does nothing with no warning
No return value check on CTrade.PositionModify, so failed modifications go unhandled and unnoticed
Does not account for the broker's minimum stop level (StopsLevel), which can cause modification requests to be rejected by the server
improvements: 使用倒序循环遍历仓位，并在PositionGetSymbol后检查是否匹配当前品种符号
添加止损修改的最小距离限制检查（SymbolInfoInteger(SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL)），并检查PositionModify返回值
为参数设置合理的非零默认值，并在OnInit中验证参数有效性，无效时发出警告或返回INIT_FAILED
improvements_en: Use reverse iteration for the position loop and check PositionGetSymbol return value against Symbol() to filter by current instrument
Add minimum stop distance validation using SymbolInfoInteger(SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL) and check CTrade.PositionModify return values for error handling
Set sensible non-zero default values for parameters and validate them in OnInit, issuing warnings or returning INIT_FAILED on invalid input

risk_points: 正向循环遍历仓位列表可能在仓位被删除时导致索引跳过，造成部分仓位未被管理
未检查品种匹配可能意外修改其他品种仓位的止损
未考虑止损级别限制可能导致修改请求频繁失败
risk_points_en: Forward iteration through the position list can skip positions if one is closed during iteration, leaving some positions unmanaged
Missing symbol filter may inadvertently modify stop-losses on positions of other symbols on the same account
Ignoring the broker's stop level may cause frequent modification request failures
